title: Outdoor train station stop
content: Like most of you, my dream world feels like its own little universe with so many different spots. Last night, I clearly remembered this one area I’ve dreamed about before. It’s an outdoor train station in the hills or mountains, and there’s a stop with long wooden tables, benches, string lights, food, drinks, and I think an area with games too. It’s a cute little spot ! Wondering if anyone has experienced the same ?
